name: Aidite (Qinhuangdao) Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Aidite (Qinhuangdao) Technology Co., Ltd. is a research and development firm of zirconia materials, dental materials, related consumables, and equipment for the dental industry in China. It offers ceramic denture zirconia repair materials, glass ceramics, elastic ceramics, resin materials, zirconia treatment agents, dental grinding and polishing burs, and dental five-axis cutting machines. The company also develops chairside restoration systems, invisible orthodontic solutions, and digital implant systems, and supplies dental implants, implant toolkits, and digital impression tools; and manufactures and sells oral hygiene products.
